recipe: configs/v4.yaml with configs/v2/stage1.yaml; only ON reference overrides deterministic_algorithms to true
origin_order: All 4090 origins in each of epochs 0,1,2; CPU randperm seed 42+epoch; full 36-origin K64 selection each epoch

restart_points.position: after final epoch-0 optimizer update and before selection; terminate worker normally after atomic save and start a fresh interpreter for selection

allocation_restarts: Additional graceful time-guard restarts permitted for any chain, recorded and audited; never skip a pending validation
controller_test: Separate small loop fixture with four identical selection scores, patience 3, boundary restart; stopping must occur at epoch 4, best at epoch 1

comparison.rule: Every persisted observation must satisfy abs(a-b) <= atol + rtol*max(abs(a),abs(b)); all finite; absolute term handles near-zero values without division
comparison.justification: Engineering equivalence bounds: at most 0.5% relative change in total loss, ES and epoch selection ES; 1% in squared balance and 2% in pre-clip gradient norm, whose sensitivity to small parameter perturbations is greater. Small absolute floors prevent meaningless near-zero ratios. These are deliberately strict bounds for same-seed trajectories, not claimed confidence intervals or historical v4 seed variability.
comparison.exact_fields: Origin order, sample noise, counters, all configuration except declared run identity/mode differences; final RNG trees; restored model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG equal saved state for every restart
comparison.stopping_epoch_comparison: Only if early stopping actually occurs; three epochs do not establish patience-3 behavior

case30.report: median and p90 synchronized production-step seconds; full worker costs, startup and non-step overhead; concurrent tile placement disclosed

case118.recipe: v4 parameters on case118 dataset/network/seed42 checkpoint, K8 B1 fp32; train-derived case118 masks/scales and real cached histories; serial isolated tile 0 runs
case118.numerical_acceptance: Finite metrics and unchanged frozen backbone only; this timing diagnostic is separate from case30 acceptance

timing.interpretation: Measure actual speedup and full cost; 1.5-1.6x is an expectation, not a gate

case118_preparation.reason: Only assets and format smoke evidence exist; an audited temporal training cache is required for production-step timing
case118_preparation.scope: Existing v4 demand/calendar generation and solver settings; 200-hour pilot then full 10 train and 2 model-selection episodes (6048 hours); no held-out labels or evaluation
case118_preparation.source_partitions: Same predeclared v4 calendar pools; coordinate scales fit on train only
case118_preparation.layout: After case30 acceptance passes: baseline solver/dual smoke and 200-hour pilot, then up to 12 independent CPU label workers; XPU embedding-cache preparation after labels/audit
case118_preparation.audit: Exact case hash and deterministic demands; independent solution checks; masks retain failed states; shard hashes; pilot prefix unchanged; valid fraction at least 0.99; all selected scales finite and positive

job.case30_layout: Fresh independent workers on isolated flat tiles 0/1/2; each asserts exactly one visible tile and selects device 0; reference may require a second allocation
job.budget_accounting: PBS allocation reservations plus actual PBS wall time; every worker subprocess including restarts/startup/validation/checkpointing recorded; missing job boundary charged full 3600 seconds and stops verification
job.retry_policy: Only clean graceful checkpoint continuation; no crash retries; stop dependent work on a failed gate

adoption: Determinism OFF only after every correctness/acceptance requirement and required timing evidence passes; retain historical ON configuration behavior and evaluation
limitations: One comparison seed is not a population-level convergence study
No claim that three epochs exercises patience-3 early stopping
No fleet or full replication training
